Ket center tensor

Extra global charge leg

16

U(1) × SU(2) symmetry · Contraction and reduction of recursive environments into a tangent center · rightward · Hubbard fermion model · MPO with a purification leg, tangent center with an extra charge leg · Center bond dimension=511: Workload and measurement settings

Contract the complete vector of precomputed recursive environment partials with the opposite-side base environments, then reduce the channel contributions into one tangent center. Preparation of the partials is outside the timed region.
